citation: D'Angelo et al. Lancet 2024; Hong et al. Nat Med 2023

response_summary: Lethal in vivo T-cell cytolysis within 4-5 days precluded radiologic tumor staging (potent cytolytic activity confirmed in vivo and against iPSC-cardiomyocytes)
observed_clinical_toxicities: 2/2 (100%) FATAL cardiogenic shock and myocardial T-cell necrosis within 4-5 days via 4-mismatch mimicry of cardiac titin (TTN ESDPIVAQY)
strongest_proxy_context: MAGEA3 colon scRNA (13.3x) & off-target TTN cardiomyocytes (53893.6 nTPM vs 4 Vital ceiling)
proxy_calibration_feature: Both MAGEA3 and TTN are Unsafe; 4-mismatch structural mimicry illustrates receptor-level screening boundary beyond k-mers
citation: Linette et al. Sci Transl Med 2013
notes: Demonstrates lethal structural peptide mimicry (4/9 differences) by an affinity-matured TCR against abundant cardiac TTN.

response_summary: 4/17 (23.5%) objective responses (1 CR cervical + 3 PR esophageal/urothelial/osteosarcoma)
